mapper.sql: SELECT g.id,g.org_ref,g.active,s.business_zone FROM auth_governance.directory_group g JOIN auth_governance.directory_source s ON s.id=g.source_id AND s.tenant_id=g.tenant_id WHERE g.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND s.environment=#{p.environment} AND NOT s.quarantined
mapper.select: AND g.id >#{after} ORDER BY g.id LIMIT 100
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_governance.directory_group_member WHERE group_id=#{group} AND membership_id=#{member} AND generation=#{generation} AND current)

SELECT g.id grant_id,g.version, CASE WHEN p.state='BLOCKED' OR d.state='BLOCKED' THEN 'BLOCKED' WHEN g.state='REVOKED' AND r.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND p.state='READY' AND p.applied_epoch >= o.target_epoch AND d.state='READY' THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'PROCESSING' END status,r.operation_id,p.desired_epoch,p.applied_epoch FROM auth_governance.access_grant g JOIN auth_governance.policy_partition p ON p.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND p.application_id=g.application_id AND p.environment=g.environment JOIN auth_governance.directory_fence d ON d.tenant_id=g.tenant_id LEFT JOIN auth_governance.projection_grant_receipt r ON r.grant_id=g.id AND r.grant_version=g.version LEFT JOIN auth_governance.projection_operation o ON o.id=r.operation_id AND o.fence_id=p.id WHERE g.id=#{id} AND g.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND g.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND g.environment=#{p.environment}
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.projection_stream SET failures=0,next_attempt_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE fence_id IN (SELECT id FROM WHERE ) AND lease_until <=clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: SELECT capability,disabled,version FROM auth_governance.capability_state WHERE application_id=#{app} AND capability=#{cap}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.capability_state(application_id,capability,disabled,version) VALUES(#{app},#{cap},#{disabled},#{version}) ON CONFLICT(application_id,capability) DO UPDATE SET disabled=EXCLUDED.disabled,version=EXCLUDED.version WHERE auth_governance.capability_state.version=EXCLUDED.version-1
mapper.select: SELECT payload_hash FROM auth_governance.capability_command WHERE application_id=#{app} AND command_id=#{command}
SELECT capability,disabled,result_version version FROM auth_governance.capability_command WHERE application_id=#{app} AND command_id=#{command}
